::: {.join-us}
**Prospective students.** I regularly supervise MSc internships and PhD theses on Discrete Event
Systems, behavior identification, digital twins and healthcare applications. Motivated
students are welcome to [contact me](mailto:gregory.faraut+pages@ens-paris-saclay.fr) with a
CV and their transcripts, even when no position is currently advertised.
:::
